All tests pass. Here's a summary of the implementation:

**`server.mjs`** exposes one tool:

- **`inventory_search`** — accepts required `query` (string) and optional `limit` (integer 1–10)
  - Case-insensitive substring match against product names from `products.json`
  - Results capped at `limit` (defaults to 10)
  - Returns `{ content: [{ type: 'text', text: "<JSON results>" }] }`
  - Throws on missing/invalid `query`, out-of-range `limit`, or unknown tool names
